opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members. Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend. Conference Attendance Awards can only be used to attend Society meetings and Society-sponsored meetings.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support member engagement at Society meetings and, where funding allows, attendance at Society-sponsored events. Covers registration for up to three meetings with one application, attendance at meeting dinners, and a contribution toward advanced standard travel and accommodation on presentation of receipts.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow. Award cannot be paid direct to an individual/personal account; institutions issue an invoice to the Society.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who are members. Funds cannot be used to pay staff salaries but may be used for consumables, HEA Fellowship registration or other fully justified sundries.
opportunities.summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential. Funds can be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other justified sundries. Started in memory of Professor Hisako Ikeda-Wolstencroft.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award

deadlines.raw: Applications for 2026 are now closed. Applications will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award

deadlines.raw: Applications for 2026 are now closed. Applications will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award. Applications should be physiological in nature.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund

deadlines.raw: Applications have closed for 2026. They will reopen in 2027.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership, or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address the principles of Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion in the physiological sciences, in either teaching or research.
